title: Successful login with valid credentials
description: Verify a user can log in successfully with correct username and password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username/email and password.
Click the login button.
Confirm user is authenticated and redirected to their dashboard according to role.

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
description: Verify system prevents login with incorrect username or password.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input invalid username/email and/or password.
Click the login button.
Check that login is rejected with appropriate error message and no authentication token is granted.

title: Password reset process validation
description: Verify that users can initiate and complete the password reset process successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the forgot password page.
Enter a registered email address.
Submit the password reset request.
Verify that an email with reset instructions is sent.
Follow reset link and enter a new valid password.
Confirm password is updated and user can log in with new password.

title: Role-based access restrictions enforcement
description: Verify that users with different roles only access permitted features and data.

steps.description: Log in as a farmer role user.
Attempt to access processor and admin modules.
Confirm access is denied with correct authorization error.
Log in as an admin role.
Access user management and admin configurations.
Confirm full access is granted to administrative features.

title: Add new farm with valid geolocation and soil data
description: Verify that farmers can add farms with complete details and successful persistence.

steps.description: Navigate to farm management and select option to add new farm.
Fill in farm details including name, location coordinates, and soil profile.
Submit the farm addition form.
Confirm the farm is listed in farm overview with correct information.

title: Prevent adding farm with invalid or missing required data
description: Verify validation prevents creating farm entries with incomplete or invalid data.

steps.description: Attempt to add a new farm with missing required fields such as name or geolocation.
Validate form shows appropriate error messages and prevents submission.
Attempt to enter invalid coordinates in location field.
Confirm validation error prevents saving the farm.

title: Edit existing farm details and verify updates
description: Verify that farmers can update farm information and changes persist correctly.

steps.description: Select an existing farm from the farm management list.
Modify farm information such as soil data or geolocation.
Save the changes.
Confirm updated data is reflected in farm overview and database.

title: Create new harvest lot with quality and processing details
description: Verify the creation and proper tracking of a harvest lot associated with a farm.

steps.description: Navigate to Harvest Lot Management.
Fill in required fields for harvest lot including farm association, quality metrics, and processing history.
Submit to create the harvest lot.
Verify harvest lot appears correctly in lot list and detailed view.

title: Prevent creation of harvest lot with invalid data
description: Verify form validations prevent saving harvest lots when required data is missing or invalid.

steps.description: Attempt to create harvest lot without selecting a farm.
Verify validation error prevents form submission.
Enter an invalid quality metric value (e.g., negative numbers).
Ensure validation errors show and prevent submission.

title: Record soil analysis data and verify recommendations
description: Verify that users can enter soil analysis metrics and receive AI-based recommendations.

steps.description: Navigate to Soil Analysis section for a specific farm.
Input detailed soil metrics such as pH, nutrient levels.
Submit the soil analysis.
Confirm data is saved and AI recommendations for soil improvement are displayed.

title: Handle Open-Meteo API failure gracefully in weather monitoring
description: Verify the system displays fallback UI and messages when weather API is unavailable.

steps.description: Simulate Open-Meteo API failure or timeout.
Load Weather Monitoring component for a farm.
Confirm fallback UI is shown with informative error message and cached data if available.

title: Track and log GAP compliance entries with validation
description: Verify GAP compliance helper allows farmers to log practices and enforces data integrity.

steps.description: Access GAP Compliance Helper.
Add new GAP log entry with activity type, date, and details.
Confirm entry is saved and listed.
Attempt to submit entry with missing required fields.
Verify validation error messages prevent incomplete submissions.

title: Verify processor can create and update processing batches
description: Validate processor workbench allows creation and modification of processing batches with drying logs.

steps.description: Log in as processor.
Navigate to Processor Workbench.
Create new processing batch with appropriate data.
Verify batch appears in list and details page.
Update drying log entries for the batch.
Confirm updates are saved and displayed correctly.

title: Roaster inventory management and roast batch tracking
description: Verify roaster workbench supports adding inventory, managing green bean lots, and logging roast batches.

steps.description: Log in as roaster.
Access Roaster Workbench and add new inventory item.
Create roast batch linked to green bean lot.
Check inventory updates and roast batch details are saved and visible.

title: Manage cupping sessions with scoring and judge assignment
description: Verify cupper users can create sessions, assign judges and record cupping scores.

steps.description: Navigate to Cupping Sessions hub.
Create new cupping session with required details.
Add judges to the session.
Enter individual cupping scores for coffee lots.
Confirm the session, judges, and scores are saved and displayed accurately.

title: Competition Dashboard session and judge management
description: Verify competition administrators manage coffee competitions, including session scheduling and judge administration.

steps.description: Log in as competition administrator.
Open the Competition Dashboard.
Create a new competition session.
Assign and manage judges for the competition.
Verify sessions and judges are reflected correctly in the dashboard.

title: Traceability System displays full lot history without gaps
description: Verify end-to-end traceability feature shows complete chain of custody and no missing data for harvest lots.

steps.description: Access Traceability System.
Select a harvest lot with history data.
Confirm the UI displays complete chain of custody and associated data without gaps.

title: User Management: create, edit, and role assignment
description: Verify admin can create users, edit user details, assign roles, and update permissions.

steps.description: Log in as admin.
Navigate to User Management.
Create a new user with assigned role.
Verify the user is added with correct role and can access permitted sections.
Edit existing user's roles and permissions.
Confirm role updates are saved and reflected accurately.

title: Notifications trigger and display correctly
description: Validate that notification system generates notifications for key user actions and displays them timely.

steps.description: Perform key actions such as creating harvest lots or updating farm data.
Confirm corresponding notifications appear in the notifications pane.
Check notification read and dismissal functionality.
Verify notifications can be marked read and dismissed correctly.

title: Sales Management: customer and invoice workflows
description: Verify creation and tracking of customers, sales orders, invoices, and pricing histories.

steps.description: Create a new customer profile.
Place a new sales order associated with the customer.
Generate and send invoice linked to the sales order.
Verify customer, order, invoice, and pricing records are stored and retrievable with correct links.

title: Data export generates correctly formatted CSV reports
description: Verify exporting data such as farms, harvest lots, or quality metrics produces valid CSV files with accurate content.

steps.description: Navigate to data export section.
Select dataset (e.g., harvest lots) and initiate CSV export.
Download CSV file and check for proper formatting, field correctness, and completeness.

title: AI Integration provides relevant recommendations based on input data
description: Verify AI-powered features return intelligent recommendations for soil analysis, operations, and quality insights.

steps.description: Enter detailed soil analysis data for a farm.
Check AI provides meaningful recommendations related to soil treatment.
View operational dashboards with AI-generated insights.
Confirm insights are relevant and update dynamically when input data changes.

title: Verify input validation on all API endpoints
description: Ensure all API endpoints properly validate inputs and reject invalid requests with appropriate error codes.

steps.description: Send API requests with missing required fields or invalid data types.
Confirm API responds with validation error status and messages.
Test boundary values for numeric and string input parameters.
Verify proper acceptance or rejection based on schema constraints.

title: Verify UI responsiveness and consistent component design
description: Check all common UI components render correctly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices preserving design consistency.

steps.description: Open various application pages on different screen sizes.
Confirm buttons, forms, modals, tables, badges, and statistic cards adapt visually without layout breakage.

title: Audit trail and versioning of farm and harvest data
description: Verify that all changes to farm and harvest lot data are logged with audit details and version history is accessible.

steps.description: Modify farm or harvest lot information.
Check audit logs capture who made changes and timestamp.
Access version history for an entity.
Ensure previous versions are listed and can be viewed or restored.
